decisions.rationale: Whimsicott is faster than Charizard and Moonblast guarantees the KO from its shown HP if Protect fails. Metagross Protect covers the only meaningful downside: a successful Protect followed by Heat Wave into the Steel slot. Charizard has no remaining ally.

reflections.summary: Led Hydreigon and Krookodile into Whimsicott+Metagross and were instantly OHKOed by Moonblast and Hammer Arm. Hawlucha was then OHKOed by Metagross. Charizard was locked into Protect by Encore and could not attack, leading to a clean sweep. The team preview plan was flawed—no Farigiraf to stop Prankster, and the leads were vulnerable to the opponent's obvious opening.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Farigiraf to lead and block Prankster, preventing Encore and Tailwind. Consider pairing it with Charizard or a partner that can threaten Metagross immediately. Avoid leading Hydreigon and Krookodile against this opponent's Whimsicott+Metagross core.
reflections.notebook: Game 1: Whimsicott (Focus Sash) with Prankster Encore, Tailwind, Moonblast; Metagross-Mega (Jolly) with Hammer Arm, Zen Headbutt, Protect. They used Tailwind+Encore to lock Charizard. Opponent also has Farigiraf (Armor Tail) and Altaria (Cloud Nine) that can counter Prankster and sun. Farigiraf must be brought to stop Prankster. Opponent's Metagross is fast and threatens with Hammer Arm. Avoid Hydreigon and Krookodile leads against this core. Future games: lead Farigiraf + strong attacker, possibly Charizard but watch for Altaria cloud removal.

reflections.summary: Won because Whimsicott + Mega Metagross was an excellent preview call into Hydreigon/Krookodile: turn-one Moonblast and Hammer Arm immediately removed both leads, then Tailwind/Encore prevented Charizard-Y from recovering momentum. The four brought suited the revealed offense; Altaria and Rotom-W were not needed.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Whimsicott + Mega Metagross as the primary plan if they again show Hydreigon/Krookodile, but avoid spending repeated attacks into an Encore-locked Protect when a switch or safer board-positioning line is available. Consider Rotom-W over Altaria if expecting Charizard-Y to be central, while retaining Metagrossite as the preferred Mega.
reflections.notebook: Opponent omitted Sinistcha and Sableye in game 1. Their likely offensive mode was Hydreigon + Krookodile with Charizard-Y and Hawlucha in back. Charizard-Y is Timid with Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Scorching Sands, and Protect; it repeatedly used Protect and can be exploited by Prankster Encore. Krookodile is Jolly Intimidate with Sitrus Berry, Earthquake, Knock Off, Close Combat, and Protect. Hydreigon is Timid Life Orb. Hawlucha is Jolly White Herb Unburden with Close Combat, Acrobatics, Taunt, and Protect. Whimsicott/Mega Metagross is a strong answer to the revealed Hydreigon-Krookodile lead; preserve Encore pressure against Charizard-Y.
